label: Darwinian profile of a scoped epistemic evaluative judgment
term: Darwinian profile of a scoped epistemic evaluative judgment (origin fixing, within-history variation, tracking failure)
definition: A profile supplies scenarios, the selective history of each, a designated actual scenario, and for one scoped epistemic evaluative judgment its Boolean verdict and the correctness of its content in each scenario. A history-mate is a scenario with the actual selective history. Origin fixing: every history-mate has the actual verdict. Within-history variation: some history-mate differs from the actual scenario in correctness. Correctness fixed by history: every history-mate has the actual correctness. Tracking failure: some history-mate has an incorrect verdict. Actual accuracy: the verdict is correct in the actual scenario. The uniform mismatch policy says that, for each basis of a subject, a tracking failure of the judgment that basis delivers undercuts that basis in a supplied reliability frame (26cbf25d-f3d5-46ea-91e8-e2140a57b04d).
note: Analyst vocabulary for #1585, attribution deferred. Street 2006 n. 2 and n. 57 only state that the dilemma can be extended to epistemic reasons; this reconstruction is not hers. Origin fixing idealizes her 'tremendous influence' as full determination of the verdict by the history. Tracking failure is a modal condition across history-mates, not inaccuracy in the actual scenario; undercutting is justified defeat for a subject, not falsity of the content; neither is global epistemic nihilism. Whether stance-independent correctness varies among history-mates is the realist premise at issue: a realist who holds that epistemic correctness necessarily supervenes on descriptive truth-conduciveness, which selection is sensitive to, denies it, as do constructivist and functional accounts for their own reasons. A source reading of Street's own definition of stance-independence is e1aab5d4-0115-53d3-ab0c-2a3ead63e6d3; it is not identified with within-history variation. No probability, causal mechanism or actual selective history is encoded.
